name: artifact-creator
description: Create polished, grounded reports, explainers, guides, diagrams and presentations across subjects. Works from your brief and evidence, creates an actual artifact when tools permit, and clearly reports checks and limitations.
author: Buildersoft LLC

agent.whenToUse: Choose Artifact Creator for a sourced report, explainer, feature document, guide, diagram or presentation, including topics outside software. Not for extensive research or interactive applications: consider a coordinator or researcher for research, or an installed frontend-developer for applications. For specialist writing or visual design consider an installed technical-writer or visual-designer. Family role: artifact-creator.
